### 🎨 Graphics quality
- The game is now anti-aliased even with effects (bloom) turned on — no more jagged edges in the default settings
- Shadows follow your character smoothly without flickering or crawling edges, keeping their full range
- Light bloom is softer and wider — glowing lights and muzzle flashes get a natural halo instead of a tight blur
- Walls and props on arena maps now darken subtly where they meet the ground, so they look grounded instead of floating
- New "Ultra" shadow quality option (2× sharper shadows) for high-end machines
- Render resolution can now be pushed up to 200% for a supersampled, extra-crisp image
